decisions.reason: The handoff timing for editable source files does not change which customer-specific fields must remain editable.
The source requests editable source files after the wording change but does not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their packaging.
The RR02 and RR03 wording change is already represented by a separate same-message MODIFY; the source-file handoff timing adds no further change to this Requirement.
The source-file handoff timing does not change the dashboard content, prominence, heading, or communication goal.
The handoff instruction does not change the content or presentation of the front-page result explanation.
Sending editable source files after the wording correction does not alter any report identifier or identifier-consistency rule.
The source-file handoff timing does not change the established exposure-band mapping.
The handoff instruction does not change footer coverage, presentation, interference rules, or version-specific identifiers.
The source-file delivery timing does not change the internal-page header's style, content, scope, or identifiers.
The instruction to deliver editable source files after completion does not modify the accepted visual style or refinement priorities.
The handoff timing does not change the distribution warning's presence, visual treatment, clarity, or footer-interference constraint.
